title: A Archive for the Signal
author: J. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
